description: v1.0.1 — Use when a directory of git checkouts needs a resume-facing GitHub portfolio audit: inventory every live original repository, score each one for release-readiness (product story, docs, tests, license, secrets, coupling, authorship), report positives and flaws with evidence, and rank a tier list. Read-only: never edit, push, or change visibility. SEO work is a later github-seo run after a repo is chosen for public release.
